reviewedInvariants.topic: Exact owner/editor and actual draft equality
reviewedInvariants.conclusion: Requires current scope and editor ID, available identity and no busy/locked/checking state; compares actual editorDraft with original record instead of trusting the effect-driven dirty flag.

The owned editor ID is retired before asynchronous cleanup. Captured record drafts are fenced before storage, after the await and on failure, preventing late republish/error or new writes from a retired editor.

The shared per-scope FIFO queue places discard after existing queued writes; discard filters only the exact owned recovery ID and retains Stop holds and other recovery entries. Cross-tab source/fork IDs remain distinct.

Optional publication predicate scopes cleanup results/errors to the original epoch, owner, identity and monotonically changing editorVersion; a replacement editor that opens and closes cannot authorize an earlier completion merely because current ID is null.

Clean close stays immediate; failed cleanup keeps its encrypted recovery copy and reports the existing localized error. A still-dirty note requires explicit confirmation even if dialogDirty lags; active editor storage failures remain visible.

Only PhoneApp lifecycle logic and the existing regression file changed. Existing English/Arabic strings, focus-restoration component, storage schemas, account/provider behavior and native source were not rewritten by this patch.

verificationEvidence.testSourceQuality: Actual PhoneApp and RecordEditor edit/submit/Keep handlers are extracted; production encrypted vault and serialized safety implementation are used with synthetic atomic storage ports. Assertions cover four repeated cycles, queued/in-flight/delayed writes, retired errors, dirty fields, other-tab forks/other records/profile/Stop holds, quota failure, owner/epoch/identity/editor drift and ABA. Existing behavioral assertions remain.

limits: Source acceptance is not a browser runtime pass. The harness does not replace actual React rendering/effect scheduling and focus checks.
Root must replay the exact repeated change-stage / Save confirmation / Keep / clean Cancel sequence in English and Arabic on the corrected preview and retain main-record/recovery/export evidence.
No final whole-tree commit, full CI, native or deployment acceptance is claimed.
No proof of pre-existing data loss or identical duplicate payloads is introduced.
